sloka: यस्य सीता भवेत् भार्या यम् च हृष्टा परिष्वजेत् ।अति जीवेत् स सर्वेषु लोकेषु अपि पुरंदरात् ॥३-३४-१९॥
transliteration: yasya sītā bhavet bhāryā yam ca hṛṣṭā pariṣvajet ।ati jīvet sa sarveṣu lokeṣu api puraṁdarāt ॥3-34-19॥

translations.english: She is a woman of good conduct, of praiseworthy beauty. She is matchless in her beauty on earth. She will be a suitable wife for you and you, a suitable husband for her.
